name: Pressure Plate
concept: A pressure plate trap set into the dungeon floor, seen from the game's raised three-quarter view: one plain square stone plate, about as wide as the large barrel is tall, standing a hand's width proud of the floor with broad chamfered edges and a few chipped corners, sitting inside a thin dark iron frame that is barely wider than a finger, with one oversized rivet at each frame corner. No runes, no spikes, no grate: just the plate and its frame, chunky and clean in the pack's style and palette, readable at a glance as something you could step on.

provenance.quality_notes: Trap plate at KayKit dungeon scale: a 1.6 m stone slab standing 0.16 m proud of the floor plane and reaching 0.12 m below it, so it rises out of any floor tile. Sinks into its separate frame (pressure_plate_frame) while pressed. No gameplay data. Pale stone_light, the KayKit floor tiles' own swatch, rather than the concept's dark stone, so it sits with the grey floors; two corners are cut straight down instead of chipped, which left slivers.
